statement: PRECHECK sec 7: the same-head control must reproduce the keeper TO THE CENT; if it does not, THAT is the finding.

verdict.scored_C3a_identical: +4.2 % / +11.5 % / +14.7 %, byte-equal to the keeper's, and the reported model level (56.45 / 38.63 / 39.46) matches at 2 dp
verdict.but_not_bit_identical: 2025 IS bit-identical (0 of 61,320 zone-hours differ). 2023 and 2024 are NOT: 5,012 and 2,465 zone-hours differ. The LARGE deltas (to $81.01 / $125.57) sit entirely on WECC_PNW / WECC_DSW, the two WECC IMPORT nodes, which carry ZERO CAISO demand and so contribute nothing to the load-weighted mean; the load-carrying zones move at most $2.30 / $2.28 in a few hundred hours. The signature is adjacent-hour price swaps at an import node -- LP alternate optima under degeneracy, not a model change.
verdict.why_it_matters: This sets the NOISE FLOOR for reading the treated arm: same-head churn is 0.0048 % / 0.0061 % / 0.0000 % of level, so any B1 C3a move above ~0.01 % of level is signal. It also qualifies caiso-180's and caiso-181's 'exactly $0.000' -- that was measured at SCORED precision, which cannot see sub-cent churn; measured hour-by-hour at full precision it is $0.000 only in 2025.
